related.title: 白鶴灘水電站
related.transfer: 可遷移「年發電量與容量因數」與「壩身孔口水舌碰撞消能」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；白鶴灘水電站的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Annual energy and capacity factor" and "Jet collision from dam-body outlets" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Baihetan Hydropower Station must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦285.5 m 拱壩的壩身孔口洩洪、地下廠房與金沙江梯級聯合調度；白鶴灘水電站則以百萬瓩級機組、289 m 雙曲拱壩與低熱水泥全壩應用為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on orifice flood discharge through a 285.5 m arch dam, underground powerhouses and joint operation of the Jinsha cascade; Baihetan Hydropower Station centres on million-kilowatt units, a 289 m double-curvature arch dam and low-heat cement throughout, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「水頭、流量與出力」與「水頭、流量與出力」的能量輸入、轉換路徑與主要環境條件。
把本課「同步轉速與發電機極數」的模型移到白鶴灘水電站，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「水錘與導葉關閉規律」為例，設計一項能區分兩個工程行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list energy inputs, conversion paths and main environmental conditions of "Head, discharge and output" and "Head, discharge and output".
Move the model of "Synchronous speed and generator poles" to Baihetan Hydropower Station, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Water hammer and guide-vane closure", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two projects and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.
related.why: 可遷移「年發電量與容量因數」與「壩身孔口水舌碰撞消能」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；白鶴灘水電站的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.whyEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Annual energy and capacity factor" and "Jet collision from dam-body outlets" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Baihetan Hydropower Station must be respecified.

以「智慧灌漿與數位化施工」為例，設計一項能區分兩個工程行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 溪洛渡水電站
history.text: 2005 年主體工程正式開工；2007 年金沙江截流；2013 年水庫下閘蓄水，首批機組投產；2014 年18 台機組全部投產。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不代表任何專案的設計或運轉文件。
history.textEn: 2005: Main works formally began. 2007: The Jinsha River was closed. 2013: Impounding began and the first units entered service. 2014: All eighteen units were in service. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering logic only, not any project's design or operating documents.
